description: A legal stock register book declared as data: which items and movements enter it, how its lines are numbered and corrected, and the columns it prints. Usually installed by an app; switched off, never deleted, once it has lines.

fields.description: The book's id in its data set, for example ke_pharmacy.poisons_book.
fields.label: Book

fields.description: The book's name as the inspector reads it.
fields.label: Title

fields.description: The set of books it belongs to, for example ke_pharmacy.
fields.label: Data set

fields.description: The instrument and clause that require the book; printed on every page.
fields.label: Cite

fields.description: A book switched off writes no line. A book with lines is switched off, never deleted.
fields.label: Enabled

fields.description: Off for a reference layout: its print says it is a starting point, not certified for the country.
fields.label: Certified

fields.description: What the book is kept on: its printed pages, this system, the regulator's own numbered book, or the regulator's own system (the shop's lines are then a working register).
fields.label: Medium

fields.description: The app that installed the book, if any.
fields.label: Installed by

fields.description: book_store: one sequence per book and register store. book_store_item: one per item.
fields.label: Numbering

fields.description: On for a ledger: a running balance per book, register store and item.
fields.label: Keeps a balance

fields.description: How the book prints a correction. A line is never edited.
fields.label: Correction

fields.description: Each line is kept whole at least this long after its period's last day (after its entry, in a book without periods); then a person's details may be erased from it by Erase persons' details. A line is never removed.
fields.label: Keep lines for (years)

fields.description: 1, 2, 3, 4, 6 or 12; periods run from 1 January. Empty: no periodic return.
fields.label: Period (months)

fields.description: 0 where the law names no day.
fields.label: Return due (days after the period)

fields.description: The role that approves a register count and signs a period off.
fields.label: Count role
Full count after a loss within (hours)

fields.description: Either {"classes": [...]} or {"item_groups": [...]}.
fields.label: Items

fields.description: Where an item's class is read, for a book that takes classes: {"item_field": …} or {"item_table", "class_field", "from_field", "axis", "group_field"}.
fields.label: Class source

fields.description: At most three, all of which must hold: field of the line, operator, value. A date column takes is set or is not set only.
fields.label: Conditions

fields.description: The columns a person's Desk submit may not leave empty.
fields.label: Required columns

fields.description: The printed columns: label and the line columns it prints.
fields.label: Columns

fields.description: detail_1 … detail_6: label and source (a sale detail, a Desk field or a record lookup). A detail with no source prints empty.
fields.label: Details

fields.description: Where the prescription, permit or pass is read, per document.
fields.label: Prescription and permit sources

fields.description: Per document type, the field counterparty, counterparty_address or reference_no is read from.
fields.label: Column sources

fields.description: Warehouses mapped to one register store: {"warehouse": "register store"}. Unmapped warehouses are their own register store.
fields.label: Register stores

lede: A book of a regulated-stock register: which items it takes, which movements enter it, and the columns it prints. A manifest installs it.
name: Retail Register Book
why: contract register_books; guide chapter 07; recipe manifest
